HeroStill.desc: OPENING frame = live hero section image. Two hands holding the matte-white 12CUT toward a sunlit classroom window, cherry-blossom and school-building bokeh, golden hour

ProductFront.desc: FRONT face: matte white body, red dome shutter top-right, red heart strap tab left, circular lens hole center-right, '12cut' embossed bottom-center

ProductBack.desc: BACK face: small circular viewfinder window, dark bezel, heart strap tab right-mirrored

ProductTop.desc: top-down: red dome shutter button, strap loop, body parting line

ProductPer.desc: 3/4 front-right perspective, hero product angle, all key elements visible

ProductExploded.desc: internal structure: 12-slot black film disc, shutter mechanism, front/back shell separation

CharA.desc: Korean woman, late 20s, new mother. Cream knit cardigan, soft natural makeup, warm exhausted joy. Three-panel: front / back / face close-up

CharB.desc: Two Korean middle-school girls, 14-15. Matching uniforms, ponytails, best-friend energy. Three-panel: front / back / face close-up

CharC.desc: Korean woman, mid-20s. Oversized beige coat, shy sparkling eyes, understated beauty. Three-panel: front / back / face close-up

Slide1.desc: 4:3 LANDSCAPE. Baby's tiny hand gripping an adult index finger. Warm skin tones, shallow DOF, soft golden backlight. Kodak Portra 400 tonality

Slide2.desc: 4:3 LANDSCAPE. Two teenage girls making peace signs, laughing mid-frame. School uniform, convenience store / hallway background. Casual flash-lit warmth

Slide3.desc: 4:3 LANDSCAPE. Couple holding hands walking away on autumn street. From behind, golden ginkgo leaves, late afternoon backlight. Hands and lower bodies only, no faces

product.name: 12CUT slide viewer
product.internal_mechanism: 12-slot black film disc (@ProductExploded), advances one position per shutter press

characters.desc: Young Korean mother, late 20s, soft natural makeup, cream knit cardigan, cradling newborn
Two Korean middle-school girls, 14-15, matching uniforms, arms linked, cheeks pressed together laughing
Korean woman, mid-20s, in love, oversized beige coat, eyes sparkling, shy smile

timeline.action: OPENS EXACTLY on @HeroStill (two hands holding the matte-white 12CUT at a sunlit classroom window, cherry-blossom bokeh, golden hour). Camera PUSHES IN toward the device and enters the 4:3 viewfinder window. Warm golden light reveals @Slide1 (baby hand gripping finger). CLICK, slide rotates LEFT (stepped) to @Slide2 (two girls peace signs). CLICK, rotates to @Slide3 (couple autumn street). Internal disc @ProductExploded visible as silhouette
timeline.camera: start frame @HeroStill, slow push-in along Z-axis into viewfinder
timeline.audio: soft room ambience then metallic mechanical shutter CLICK on each rotation

timeline.action: Camera PULLS BACK through viewfinder (@ProductBack -> @ProductPer as angle widens), device held in two hands. Continue back to Person A (@CharA) lowering 12CUT from her eye, face breaks into tearful-happy smile, eyes glistening, chin trembling. Newborn sleeps on her chest
timeline.camera: smooth pull-back along Z-axis, slight micro-drift on face
timeline.audio: soft fabric rustle, baby breathing, gentle exhale

timeline.action: HARD CUT to viewfinder interior: slide CLICKS, rotates LEFT. HARD CUT to Person B (@CharB) pressing 12CUT (@ProductPer) between their faces, peering from opposite sides, BURST into giggles, shoulders shaking, one playfully shoving the other

HARD CUT to viewfinder interior: slide CLICKS, rotates LEFT. HARD CUT to Person C (@CharC) holding 12CUT to her eye one hand, other hand on chest. Pulls it away slowly, bites lower lip, eyes welling with happy nostalgia, single tear catches light. FRONT face (@ProductFront) briefly visible as she lowers it (lens hole, red heart strap tab, '12cut' text)

Camera PUSHES FORWARD back into viewfinder. Two final slides rotate with deliberate slow CLICKS. Photographs glow with intensifying warm golden light, overexposing gently until frame fills with soft amber warmth

Warm light resolves into clean cream/warm-white background. 12CUT device (@ProductFront, matched exactly) centered at 25-30% frame, FRONT face to camera (lens hole, red dome shutter, red heart strap tab, '12cut' text accurate). Perfectly still. Text fades in below: '따뜻한 빛으로 보는 12장의 행복한 기억', then '12CUT' logo appears beneath. ZERO motion. Hold

camera.allowed: slight organic micro-drift during human close-ups only

lighting.viewfinder_interior: warm amber backlight bleeding through slides
lighting.human_closeups: soft diffused window light camera-left, subtle rim light camera-right
lighting.endcard: clean even soft light, no harsh shadows

elements: mechanical film slide CLICK (metallic, satisfying, precise) per rotation

style.look: cinematic film emulation, Kodak Portra 400 color science
style.tonality: lifted shadows, warm midtones, soft highlight rolloff
style.depth_of_field: shallow on human close-ups (f/1.8 equivalent), sharp focus on product endcard

strict_constraints: Opening first frame MUST be @HeroStill exactly (the live hero section image), then push-in into the viewfinder
Viewfinder window: 4:3 LANDSCAPE rounded-rectangle only (NO square, NO circle)
Product body: matte white only, rounded-square, match @ProductFront exactly
Shutter button: red dome, top-right corner, match @ProductTop exactly
Heart strap tab: red with white heart cutout, match @ProductFront left side exactly
Lens hole: circular, center-right of FRONT face, match @ProductFront exactly
'12cut' text: embossed, bottom-center of FRONT face, match @ProductFront exactly
Internal disc: 12-slot black film disc, match @ProductExploded structure
Slides rotate LEFT (mechanical, stepped, NOT smooth)
Slide photos: 4:3 LANDSCAPE ratio, match @Slide1 @Slide2 @Slide3 colour and tone
NO text overlaid on footage until endcard [12-15s]
Endcard product: FRONT face (@ProductFront), centered, ZERO motion
NO music track, sound design only
LEFT INDEX FINGER presses shutter in any visible press, NEVER right hand
Person A/B/C must match @CharA/@CharB/@CharC references for face and build consistency
